latest_release.body:

* docs(planning): add the Coolify one-click service plan by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3181
* fix(mcp): unmap the retired write switch columns (TP6 phase 2) by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3182
* fix(mcp): drop the retired write switch columns (TP6 phase 3) by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3184

* fix(calendar): enter appointments from an attached file in one turn by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3192
* refactor(tools): one agent loop for document chat and both gateways by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3193
* feat(deploy): add Coolify service file by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3195
* refactor(runs): run kernel and BRUNS, extracted from the research engine by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3198
* chore(deps): update frontend dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3172
* refactor(research): enhance UI components and save functionality by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3200
* chore(deps): update docker digests by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3190
* refactor(research): research runs on the run kernel by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3201
* chore(deps): update qdrant/qdrant docker tag to v1.20.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3197
* chore(deps): update ghcr.io/metadist/synaplan-tts:latest docker digest to 4cdf1d6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3196
* docs(deploy): Coolify update, backup and restore as measured by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3199
* fix(deploy): pin Coolify qdrant to v1.20.2 like the quickstart by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3206
* feat(setup): new installations start with sign-up off and no Free-plan usage by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3203
* fix(pricing): pin Mistral Large 3 off the moving alias by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3204
* feat(update): link the update notice to a Coolify guide on Coolify installs by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3208


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/compare/v5.8.8...v5.8.9

detail.readme:
**Own the flow.** Build agents on your own documents and put them wherever work happens: web, WhatsApp, email, Outlook, Nextcloud and ownCloud. Mix local models with the best cloud AI, see what every answer costs, and decide what the AI is allowed to do – open source, on your server or ours. [**Run it in up to five minutes**](#quickstart)  ·  [**Try it hosted**](https://web.synaplan.com/)  ·  [**Docs**](https://docs.synaplan.com/)  ·  [**Discord**](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/metadist/synaplan)](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/releases) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/metadist/synaplan?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) Self-hosting is free. The hosted version opens with a paid plan or an invitation code – ask us at team@synaplan.com.

Chat, the cost of every answer, your files, generated media and connected apps – in about 30 seconds.

▶ Watch the full demo on YouTube

--- ## Own the flow - **Own your channels.** The AI answers on your website, in WhatsApp, by email, in Outlook and inside Nextcloud and ownCloud – with the same knowledge and the same rules everywhere. - **Own your models.** Hundreds of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, sovereign EU providers or locally via Ollama. Mix them per task: sensitive work stays local, everything else gets the best model for the job. - **Own your costs.** Every answer shows its model and price. A planner splits bigger requests into steps and spends the expensive model only where it matters. - **Own the decisions.** Actions like sending mail or creating tickets wait for your approval, and every step is logged. **Running in production at** Megaherz Yoga · SANI Pflegedienst · National Secure Cloud · PlateArt --- ## Quickstart **You need:** Docker with Compose v2 and 8 GB of RAM. ```bash git clone https://github.com/metadist/synaplan.git cd synaplan make up ``` Open ****, log in as `admin@synaplan.com` / `admin123` and say hello. Your first message starts the **Synaplan Demo – no API key needed** (40 messages a day for 14 days, [how it works](https://docs.synaplan.com/demo)). When you're ready, add [your own key](https://docs.synaplan.com/own-ai-keys) (free: [Groq](https://console.groq.com)) or run [local models with Ollama](https://docs.synaplan.com/modules/local-ai). The first start downloads everything and takes 5–15 minutes. After that, Synaplan starts in seconds. > [!IMPORTANT] > These logins are for trying Synaplan on your own machine. On a server, use the [installer](#install-it-your-way) – it creates its own admin password. --- ## Install it your way | Where | How | Guide | | --- | --- | --- | | **Published image, no git** | One `compose.yaml`, then `docker compose up -d` | [Published image](docs/PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md#published-image-no-git-checkout) | | **Docker GUI** | Portainer, Dockge, Synology: paste the compose file as a stack | [Docker GUI](docs/PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md#published-image-no-git-checkout) | | **Closed network** | No route to the internet, HTTPS on your LAN address | [Closed network](docs/PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md#closed-network) | | **Linux server** | The installer pins a release, generates secrets and runs a smoke test | [On a server](docs/PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md#on-a-server) | | **Kubernetes** | Helm charts for clusters | [synaplan-charts](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan-charts) | | **One click** | [RepoCloud](https://repocloud.io/details/Synaplan/) · [Elestio](https://elest.io/open-source/synaplan) | – | | **Public sector (EU/CH)** | openDesk, Nextcloud and OpenCloud, on-premises or in an EU cloud | [synaplan.eu](https://www.synaplan.eu/) | A Linux server in one line: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/metadist/synaplan/main/install.sh | \ bash -s -- --mode server --domain https://ai.example.com ``` **Own the stack.** On-prem, EU cloud or fully air-gapped. No training on your data, no forced telemetry, no feature paywall: self-hosted Synaplan is the same software as our cloud, under Apache-2.0. --- ## How it compares People usually arrive comparing Synaplan with a chat window or an app builder. This is what each project is for. It is not a scoreboard. | | Synaplan | Open WebUI | LibreChat | Dify | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | What it is | A team platform: chat, your files as knowledge, a site widget, and the same AI on WhatsApp and email | A chat interface for local and cloud models | A chat app for many providers | A builder for AI apps and workflows | | First run | Several containers, 8 GB of RAM | One container | A Compose stack | A Compose stack, and a hosted cloud | | Cost of an answer | Shown on the answer | Not on the answer | Not on the answer | In the builder's usage logs, not on the chat answer | | Same AI on your site, WhatsApp and email | Yes | No | No | Site widget yes. WhatsApp and email are not built in | If you only want a chat window, Open WebUI or LibreChat gets you there faster. --- ## Where the AI shows up | Surface | What it does | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | | **Web app** | Full chat and admin UI, light and dark, five languages | This repo | | **Mobile apps** | Chat, documents and voice on iPhone and Android – on web.synaplan.com or your own server | [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6784278288?ct=github-readme) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synaplan.app&referrer=utm_source%3Dgithub-readme) | | **Outlook add-in** | Find and process mail inside Outlook (Web, new & classic, Mac) without sending it anywhere | [Synamail](https://github.com/metadist/Synamail) | | **Chat widget** | An AI chat on any website with one snippet, human takeover included | [Widget guide](https://docs.synaplan.com/widget) | | **WhatsApp & email** | The AI answers on the channel the question came in on | [WhatsApp](docs/WHATSAPP.md) · [Email](docs/EMAIL.md) | | **Nextcloud, ownCloud & OpenCloud** | Use the AI inside your file cloud, with its files as knowledge – your file store stays in charge | [Nextcloud](https://web.synaplan.com/apps/nextcloud) · [ownCloud](https://web.synaplan.com/apps/owncloud) · [OpenCloud](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan-opencloud) | | **Synaplan Desktop** | Pair a computer and run skills on it (no installer yet – build from source) | [synaplan-desktop](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan-desktop) | | **MCP & Claude Code** | Your knowledge and memories as MCP tools, plus an Anthropic-compatible endpoint | [MCP guide](https://docs.synaplan.com/mcp) | **Connects to** Microsoft 365 · Dropbox · Nextcloud / ownCloud / WebDAV · CalDAV · IMAP · Jira & Confluence · your own MCP servers – [how to connect](docs/CONNECTIONS.md) --- ## Troubleshooting | Problem | What to do | | --- | --- | | "Port already in use" on start | A port Synaplan needs is taken – see [Port conflicts](docs/INSTALLATION.md#port-conflicts) | | Containers stop right after start | Give Docker at least 8 GB of RAM, then check `docker compose logs -f backend` | | Chat gives no answers | Use the Synaplan Demo, paste one provider key, or add the `local-ai` profile – see the [quickstart](#quickstart) | | First start seems stuck | The first start downloads all images and takes 5–15 minutes. `docker compose logs -f startup-notes` shows where it is | | Anything else | Ask in [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) or open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/issues) | --- ## Under the hood - **Stack:** Symfony (PHP) backend, Vue frontend, MariaDB VECTOR or Qdrant for document search, Redis, Docker. - **Lean core:** app, database and Redis. Local AI, office files, web search, voice and more are building blocks you switch on when you need them. - **Open by design:** OpenAPI REST API, MCP server and client, an Anthropic-compatible `/v1/messages` endpoint and a plugin system – extend Synaplan without forking it. [Docs](https://docs.synaplan.com/) · [Technical manual](docs/README.md) · [Platform reference](docs/PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md) · [Discussions](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/discussions) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) Changing the code? Start with [adding an AI provider](docs/PROVIDERS.md) or [following a tool call](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#tool-path). [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) is the guide for coding agents. --- ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) · Built in Düsseldorf by [metadist](https://www.synaplan.com) · Member of the Open Source Business Alliance
